ev_0004.summary: Consolidated the octagon A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H from the supervisor-verified labelled vertices and the CV line detections. All 8 vertices are confirmed and bound to their letters. The 8 octagon sides and the 3 interior segments EA, AC, EC are confirmed by CV detect_lines, with fragments merged into full spans. Endpoints were snapped to vertices (overshoots of 1-2 px). No right angles are verified, so none are submitted. The circumscribed circle is not drawn and is not included as an object. Vertex distances from the centre (~456.5, 452.5) are about 353 px, which conflicts with the CV circle fit of radius 331 px. The extra bind_point_labels points (point_06..point_23) are not geometric vertices and are excluded.
